fusions.name: Swarm Front
fusions.desc: Pushes your shield into a cone 3 tiles ahead under a cloud of locusts, dealing 10 damage with a 40% chance to leave each enemy [Sundered] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Stripped Bare
fusions.desc: Grinds your shield into the target under a cloud of locusts, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Living Screen
fusions.desc: Calls a cloud of locusts around you for 10 seconds that bites an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second.

fusions.name: Grazing Guard
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, 15% of the damage you deal heals you for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. Your armour is 5% higher.
